gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.note: Google AI Studio API key required. Free-tier quotas depend on the model.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.note: Cloud model marketplace. Free models still need an OpenRouter API key and have rate limits.

freerouter.name: FreeRouter
freerouter.note: A self-hosted free-model router. Start FreeRouter on the backend machine; a gateway key is optional unless your router requires one.

groq.name: Groq
groq.note: Groq API key required. Free-tier quotas apply.

ollama.name: Local Ollama
ollama.note: No API key. Install Ollama and download a model on the machine running the backend. Hosted deployments need an administrator-configured Ollama connection.
